messages:
Sam: quick note — started a 1% canary for model v5-int4 on rwd-nlg. Early telemetry: big cost/latency wins but a concentrated hit on 'spec-extract' slice. Posting mini-summary.

Marta: thanks, paste the slice numbers pls.

Sam: from 1.8k sampled requests: 
```
slice | base_RL | v5-int4_RL | delta_pct
spec-extract | 0.74 | 0.66 | -10.8%
short-answer | 0.82 | 0.80 | -2.4%
conversational | 0.79 | 0.78 | -1.3%
```

Priya: that's significant for spec-extract. is this hallucination or entity-drop?

Sam: diff shows entity omission and occasional proto-schema mismatch — answers lose exact field names. hallucinations per1k up 9 -> 27. Likely quant granularity on embedding dims for entity tokens.

Dong: which quant backend and knobs? groupwise or per-channel? any outlier clamp tweaks?

Sam: per-channel int4, nf4-style scales, outlier_clip: 0.1%, kv_fp16. config snippet: 
```
quant: per_channel_int4
outlier_clip: 0.001
kv_dtype: fp16
seed: 555
```

Marta: rollout-gate suggestion: hold at 1% and don't escalate until either spec-extract delta <5% OR human review of top-150 fails shows <=1% critical schema errors. For auto-fallback propose a coalesced rule: require two independent triggers within window to reduce flapping.

Priya: agree. propose min_samples_per_slice=1600, eval_window=45m, required_trigger_count=2. Also weight hallucination x2 when computing composite safety.

Dong: add exact-match-on-schema as a metric (very sensitive for spec-extract). Also track user_format_reject_rate.

Sam: drafted fallback yaml: 
```
auto_fallback:
  min_samples_per_slice: 1600
  eval_window: 45m
  required_trigger_count: 2
  triggers:
    - metric: spec_schema_exact_match_drop_pct
      threshold: -3.0
      weight: 1.5
    - metric: hallucination_per1k_abs
      threshold: 5
      weight: 2.0
    - metric: rouge_l_delta_pct
      threshold: -4.0
      weight: 1.0
```

canary-bot: Canary digest (v5-int4) — traffic=1% for 1.2h, samples=1800, p50 latency -13%, p95 -19%, token-cost -30%, fallback_state=not_triggered.

Marta: action items: Sam -> run targeted 12k spec-extract sweep + push top-150 to human review; Dong -> reproduce quant locally with seed 555 and run schema exact-match; Priya -> implement required_trigger_count=2 and composite weighting in gate service. We'll keep this thread as canonical.

Priya: small note — coalescing triggers reduced false positives in our last beta, but it delays rollback; tradeoff acknowledged.

Sam: pushing eval link now: https://internal/redwood/evals/v5-int4/spec-extract-sweep — will update when human review completes.

Marta: thanks all, hold scale until human pass + composite <0.2.
